outcome: Infant death/transfer to acute inpatient facility
cohort: 200 pregnant women with renal agenesis and 800 pregnant women with two kidneys, matched for age, race, and history of hypertension
finding: Women with unilateral renal agenesis were at increased risk for preterm delivery, cesarean section, preeclampsia/eclampsia, and longer hospital stays compared to women with two kidneys.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery: 37.9±2.1 weeks for women with renal agenesis vs. 38.6±1.8 weeks for women with 2 kidneys
